causal_sensitivity.construction: reconstruct post-attention RMSNorm input from normalized teacher state plus attention output, align the exact MLP output to the normalized semantic trace, replace it with the oracle-sparse output, add the residual, and compare normalized next boundaries
causal_sensitivity.limitation: the trace does not contain perturbed downstream rollouts or layer Jacobians, so this is not a full causal confirmation

risk.metric: teacher-forced one-step normalized residual-boundary relative L2
risk.robust_fit: minimize the worse per-arm risk across disjoint even/odd sequence splits

decision: run one untouched causal confirmation of this frozen schedule; do not treat this fitted validation result as a gate pass
scope: all 30 MLP layers; exact-membership oracle; separate controller validation trajectory only

validation_trace.explicitly_excluded: causal confirmation datasets and offset-8 confirmation result
